label: Every giving by a one-power HAS_INTELLECT_1 being is by a rational power
description: The intellect route to willed giving (argument A). It is the route that discriminates choice from chance without restating the chance rival's denial: given one power, an intellectual source cannot give by a non-rational power (controls, laws 6 and 13). Its price for the chance rival is the source's intellect. Not a transcription. Establishes no premise; nothing about God or about which worlds y gives in. Omission models: without will following intellect, without will as a rational power, without giving as exercise.
